subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

INITIATE
solution:
The correct answer is '**Conclude**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Initiate**' is '**Conclude**'.
 
• **Initiate**: to start something. (आरंभ करना, श्रीगणेश या सूत्रपात करना)
 
 
• *Example: to **initiate** peace talks...*
 
 
 
• **Conclude**: to form an opinion as to the result of thought or study. (सोच-विचार या अध्ययन के बाद निष्कर्ष या नतीजे पर पहुँचना)
 
 
• *Example: From the man’s strange behavior I **concluded** that he was drunk.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Conclude.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Launch**: to send a ship into the water or a spacecraft into the sky. [(नए) जहाज़ को पानी में उतारना या अंतरिक्ष यान को अंतरिक्ष में भेजना]
 
• **Begin**: to start doing something; to do the first part of something. [(कोई काम) आरंभ करना, शुरू करना; पहले चरण का आरंभ करना]
 
• **Inspire**: to make somebody want to do or create something. (कुछ करने या रचने की इच्‍छा उत्‍पन्‍न करना; प्रेरित करना)
